body: Brian Thomas Jr. faces significant trade pressure as ESPN proposes moving him to a fellow AFC team while the Las Vegas Raiders are urged to finalize a deal amid rising Jaguars tension. Conversely, reports suggest the Seattle Seahawks have made a blockbuster trade proposal for the wide receiver.

findings.evidence_quote: Raiders Urged to Finalize Brian Thomas Jr. Trade As Jaguars Tension Peaks
Seahawks Blockbuster Trade Proposal Lands Former First-Round WR Brian Thomas Jr.
